title: Irrationality after one stabilization of universally CH0-trivial cubic threefolds
description: This preprint proves that X times P1 is irrational for every smooth complex cubic threefold X. It also constructs a non-isotrivial A5-invariant family whose members are universally CH0-trivial, so universal CH0-triviality and the quantum obstruction diverge on the same stabilized varieties. The cycle argument proves all-degree integral saturation for marked finite-etale graph quotients of elliptic powers. The quantum argument defines a primitive-sixth framed-monodromy multiplicity, proves its birational invariance through dimension four, and also gives one-step irrationality for every smooth prime Fano threefold of genus eight.
